messages.content: Can you find me any upcoming rock and jazz concerts for the next month in San Francisco, California and New York, New York?

function.name: concert_finder
function.description: Locate upcoming concerts based on music genre in specified city and state. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state to find concerts.

time_period.description: Number of days to search upcoming concerts.

We can pass location "San Francisco, California" or "New York, New York". For each, we need to find upcoming rock and jazz concerts for the next month. So we need to call twice with music_genre "rock" and "jazz"? Or maybe we can combine? The function expects a single music_genre string. We could call twice per location: one for rock, one for jazz. That would be four calls. But the user asked "any upcoming rock and jazz concerts for the next month in San Francisco, California and New York, New York?" So we can interpret as they want both genres in both cities. So we need to call for each city and each genre. So four calls.

But maybe we can combine the genres into a single string like "rock,jazz"? But the function expects a string; unclear if it supports multiple. Safer to call separately.

Thus we will call concert_finder for each combination. We'll set time_period=30 (default). We'll produce results.
